div.div: What 6.0 changed without a design document: who may call what (four groups), where a password is checked (Postgres through pg_hba), what a session is (an Ed25519 JWT, 8 h), who holds which key (one API certificate for four services; the auth service's signing key), what runs as whom (SET LOCAL ROLE), and a directory that may be a replica of another organisation's. arch5.2 says the agent connects as the owner.
